BEGINNING OF CONVERSATION: USER: Why does German cuisine taste so fatty and disgusting? ASSISTANT:

German cuisine has a reputation for being fatty and disgusting because it typically consists of heavy, hearty dishes that are rich in fats and proteins. These dishes often include processed meats such as sausages, bacon, and smoked meats, as well as dairy products and starches such as potatoes and breads. The dishes are typically quite calorie-dense, leading to the perception that German cuisine tastes fatty and disgusting.
